title: Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransfer message
text: The UE shall set the contents of the ULInformationTransfer message as follows:
1 >  if the upper layer provides NAS PDU:
2 >  set the dedicatedNAS-Message to include the information received from upper layers;
1 >  <condition > for the IAB-MT,   if there is a need to transfer F1-C related information:
1 >  submit the ULInformationTransfer message to lower layers for transmission,   upon which the procedure ends.
